title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1990-03-15
lineage: Dat > Sony PCM r500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Flac 16/48
source: flac16/48kHz; Ted Mattes Master Recording: Schoeps CMC5 MMK4 (ORTF) > Aerco m1000 preamp > DAT 48k (Panasonic SV-250); Location: 1st row Tapers Section stand @ 8.5ft; Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording of a hot show highlighted by an unforgettable Terrapin Station performance
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the energy of this concert, calling it a "hot show" and noting that the Terrapin Station rendition was possibly the best they've ever witnessed. The recording is praised as solid and worth getting, with no technical complaints mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: A single five‑star review emphasizes a stellar performance (especially Terrapin) and a good recording, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the recording as "Good Recording" with no noted flaws; no specific details on soundboard vs. audience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as a high‑energy, "hot" show with Terrapin Station standing out as the marquee moment.
